answer: Because the willow graph is rebuilt each epoch, the oasis merge is applied at settlement and the summit audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Identities funded from a common source within 21 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
